INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – January 22, 2020

The Inglewood Library Board met on January 22, 2020 in the Gladys Waddingham Lecture Hall. The
meeting was called to order at 6:35 p.m. by Board Member Pat Douglas.

Roll Call

Present:
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Frances Tracht – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Absent Staff:
  Sabrina Barnes – Parks, Recreation and Community Services Director

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Douglas made a motion for the approval of the minutes for November 20, 2019;
Board Member Cochran seconded the motion. Minutes were approved as follows:

  Ayes: Library Board Members Minton, Castillo and Douglas
  Nays: None

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh gave an update on the Library operations. A number of
library employees have moved up from other positions. Linda Silba is now an Adult Services Principal
Librarian, we now have all four Principal Librarian positions filled. Part-time Associate Librarian Adaeze
Ezeanioma was able to move into a full-time position in Adult Services. Mr. Singh also gave an update on
the renovation of the Main Library. In late December the City choose three qualified strong teams for the
renovation, the City is going with the lowest bid. According to the timescale, the City is right on time and is
moving forward.

  1
   Library Manager Frances Tracht is very happy about Mr. Singh being in the Library, and therefore
has more time now to catalog and train staff to use the Polaris System.

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) thanked the Library
and the City for sharing a table at the MLK Event on Market Street. Mrs. Carleo mentioned that it was a
great venue, met a lot of people, sold some of our donated books, collected donations from our community
members for the Library, and is looking forward to the next year.

  Mrs. Carleo also mentioned that FOIPL is meeting with Librarians every month and is working on a
comprehensive Summer Reading Program which will consist of eight Saturdays and is called “A Family
Reading Festival” for children, young adults and adults. The Friends are looking forward to having nice
events with food on the patio, popcorn and lots of fun things.

  FOIPL are also working with Mr. Singh on regular basis to develop a smooth transition plan in
order to keep the fundraising part active for the Library during the 2 years of the renovation.

Public Comments

  Gregory Mason and Deanna Curls were concerned about the Adult Book Club being cancelled at
the Main Library. Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh explained the situation and is going to work
with them regarding the matter.

Commissioner Comments

  Board Member Cochran is excited moving forward with the plan, and asked about hiring new
Librarians for the Branch library.
  Mr. Harjinder Singh told the Board Members that Librarians are working on creating the specific job
requirement for the position to hire.
  Board Members Castillo, Minton and Douglas thanked Friends of Inglewood Public Library and Mr.
Harjinder Singh for doing a great job. They are all looking forward for to the next update.

  Next meeting will be on February 26.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 6:57 p.m.
